title: Now send a real email
drDigitalIntro:
You have composed, replied, forwarded, attached and archived in the practice mailbox. Now use your own.
• Open your email and write to someone who will not mind a test message — a friend, or yourself.
• Put something useful in the subject line. 'Hello' tells the reader nothing.
• Attach a photo or a file, then send it.
• When a reply arrives, use Reply rather than starting a new message, so the conversation stays together.
drDigitalSuccess: Everything you practised is in your real mailbox too, under slightly different names.
drDigitalHint: Read along, then send one real email from your own account.
